content: भेदः [भिद् घञ्] .²1 Breaking; splitting, cleaving; hitting (as a mark). .²2 Rending, tearing. .²3 Dividing, separating. .²4 Piercing through, perforation. .²5 .³({%a%}) Breach, rupture. .³({%b%}) Breaking open, bursting; <ls>V. 2. 7</ls>. .²6 Disturbance, interruption. .²7 Division, separation. .²8 A chasm, gap, fissure, cleft. .²9 A hurt, injury, wound. .²10 Difference, distinction; तयोर्न भेदप्रतिपत्तिरस्ति मे <ls>Bh. 3. 99</ls>; अगौरवभेदेन <ls>Ku. 6. 12</ls>; <ls>Bg. 18. 19</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 18.">22</ls>. रस˚, काल˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; भेदाभेदयोर्भेदो ग्रहीतव्यः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 6. 3</ls>. .²11 A change, modification; न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् <ls>Bg. 3. 26</ls>. .²12 Dissension, disunion. .²13 Disclosure, betrayal; as in रहस्यभेदः. .²14 Treachery, treason; भेदाधीनं कृतं शत्रोः सैन्यं शत्रुबलं स्मृतम् <ls>Śukra. 4. 876</ls>. .²15 A kind, variety; भेदाः पद्मशङ्खादयो निधेः <ls>Ak.</ls>; शिरीषपुष्पभेदः <ab>&c.</ab> .²16 Dualism. .²17 (In politics) Sowing dissensions in an enemyʼs party and thus winning him over to oneʼs side, one of the four Upāyas or means of success against an enemy; see उपाय and उपायचतुष्टय; परस्परं तु ये द्विष्टाः क्रुद्धभीतावमानिताः . तेषां भेदं प्रयुञ्जीत परमं दर्शयेद् भयम् .. <ls>Agni P.</ls> .²18 Defeat. .²19 (In medicine) Evacuation of the bowels. .²20 Shooting pain (in the limbs). .²21 Paralysis. .²22 Contraction. .²23 A conjunction of the planets. .²24 The hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle.
